facts.value: 16th-century reformation on the Genevan pattern. Presbyterian polity established 1690

citations.excerpt: It was reformed in the 16th century after the Genevan and Calvinistic pattern. A century and a half of ecclesiastical struggles followed, until in 1690 the Church of Scotland was established in its Presbyterian polity.

facts.value: The national Presbyterian church of Scotland. Various secessions in the 18th and 19th centuries were largely reunited by 1929.

citations.excerpt: Various secessions occurred in the 18th and 19th centuries, but since 1929 the Church of Scotland has been largely reunited.

facts.value: 1.15 million members (WCC figure). About 553,000 adult communicants
